title: Macro-bearing HTTP URL
description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL that may contain byte-preserved macro delimiters not legal in a strict URI, including `%%...%%`, `[...]`, and `${...}`. Plain URLs retain normal URI validation. Macro-bearing URLs require a valid lexical authority and valid percent triplets; an AdCP verifier replaces each declared token with an unreserved sentinel and validates the resulting absolute HTTP(S) URI. Token semantics are established only by `macro_declarations`.

verifier_constraints.macro_aware_uri: mask recognized token lexical forms with an RFC3986 unreserved sentinel, whether declared or on the undeclared 3.x compatibility path, then require a valid absolute HTTP or HTTPS URI; masking assigns no semantics
